name: Apify Actor
author: hearth-team
description: Run any Apify actor and get the dataset items back. Defaults to async mode — the actor runs in the background (up to 60 min) and Hearth posts the results into your chat / Telegram when ready. Pass mode='sync' for fast actors under 90s. Bring your own APIFY_API_TOKEN.

vault_inputs.label: Apify API Token
vault_inputs.help: Console → Settings → Integrations → API → 'Personal API token'. Stored encrypted in the vault.

family.name: Apify Family
family.description: Web, social, and data scraping via Apify's actor library. One API token unlocks all 18 specialized scrapers.
